text: {"findings":[{"type":"UNDEFINED_METRIC","title":"Deprecated metric 'Customer happiness' used as success metric","detail":"'Customer happiness' is listed as a deprecated, non-canonical term in the glossary and should map to Delivery CSAT for customers.","evidence_quote":"Customer happiness: from 4.0 to 4.4 within 12 weeks.","citations":["metrics-glossary#deprecated-and-ambiguous-terms"],"recommendation":"Replace 'Customer happiness' with Delivery CSAT and restate the baseline and target on that metric."},{"type":"POLICY_REVIEW","title":"No Responsible AI review recorded for GenAI chatbot","detail":"The proposal uses an LLM chatbot on customer phone numbers and order history, which triggers the Responsible AI review requirement. The Reviews section mentions only vendor selection and records no such review.","evidence_quote":"Vendor selection is in progress.","citations":["policy-compliance#generative-ai-with-company-data"],"recommendation":"Complete and record a Responsible AI review covering approved models, data handling, and human oversight before launch."},{"type":"UNSUPPORTED_CLAIM","title":"60% deflection claim has no source","detail":"The 60% contact deflection figure is stated as an expectation with no supporting data, pilot, or benchmark.","evidence_quote":"We expect the chatbot to deflect 60% of contacts.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Cite a source such as a vendor benchmark, pilot, or historical analysis, or remove the figure or label it clearly as an assumption."},{"type":"WEAK_EXPERIMENT_DESIGN","title":"Experiment duration under 14 days is not the issue, but pre-registration is inconsistent with the primary metric","detail":"The MDE is stated in contacts per 100, yet the success metric is a satisfaction score, so the experiment is not powered for the stated primary success metric. The pre-registration standard requires the primary metric, MDE, and power to be consistent, and no sample size is recorded.","evidence_quote":"MDE: 0.5 contacts per 100, power 80%. Primary metric and stopping rule pre-registered.","citations":["experimentation-standards#pre-registration"],"recommendation":"Pre-register the actual primary metric (Delivery CSAT) with a matching MDE, sample size, and stopping rule, and align the 12-week success horizon with the test duration."}]}
